title: COIN-M quarterly cash-and-carry on altcoins: long spot / short the inverse quarterly in the same coin
amendment: research/PROTOCOL_V3.md Ændring 8 (F2, phase B; design research/AENDRING8_DESIGN.md (D) F2)

disclosed: No COIN-M file was read or requested while this file was drafted (none is cached; point 17 forbids requests before 2026-11-28).
The design review of 2026-10-18 saw only the aggregate settled-funding distribution of the cached USD-M files (amendment 8 point 20); dbasis uses no funding.

Every threshold below was copied unchanged from the design written 2026-10-18, before any basis was seen; the rule wording follows the design (thresh exits at the roll). Only synthetic data (lab/families/dbasis.py convergence_selftest) was computed.

No dbasis signal or return was computed on real data.

mechanism.return_source: the basis locked between spot and an inverse COIN-M quarterly in the same coin, which converges by contract at delivery
mechanism.non_price_prediction: Both legs are the same coin: long 1 coin spot and short an inverse quarterly with face F0 USD is worth S * F0 / F, the ratio S / F, which converges to 1 at delivery. P&L = convergence of the locked basis - costs; the price delta is ~0. Signals read only the size of the basis now, never price direction or relative price between coins.

attribution.rule: carry - (fees + spread + slippage) > 0 AND basis_and_price_pnl <= carry, where carry = the basis the held quarterly locks, accrued while held: per bar pos x ln(F / S) at the previous close x hours / hours to expiry; basis_and_price_pnl = gross ratio P&L - carry; both summed per hour as the engine sums gross P&L (equal-weight mean over the coins with a row); in-sample (validation) and forward

evidence.ref: Binance COIN-M quarterly delivery: 08:00 UTC on the last Friday of March, June, September and December (lab/engine/data.py quarterly_expiry)
evidence.status: unverified (checked against the archive's contract names by the coverage check)

evidence.ref: Schmeling, Schrimpf & Todorov, BIS Working Paper 1087, Crypto carry (dated futures basis as the carry measure)

graveyard_acknowledged.materially_different_because: materially different because carry_v1 earned perp funding on 19 Hyperliquid spot pairs from 2024-12 with weekly top-5 re-ranking whose fees exceeded the funding; dbasis earns no funding at all: it locks a dated-futures basis that converges by contract at delivery, on Binance COIN-M quarterlies with explicit two-leg costs and at most one contract change per quarter

materially different because L22 traded minute-level perp premium convergence that was not locked by any contract and lost 31.6-33.4 bp net to costs; dbasis holds a quarterly whose basis is locked and converges at a known delivery date, decides once a day at 01:00 UTC and holds for weeks

materially different because F1 filt earned USD-M perp funding, whose sign and size reset every settlement and failed its train gate (net Sharpe -1.12); dbasis earns no funding: the basis it enters is locked by a dated contract until it rolls 3 days before delivery, so the cash flow is known at entry

materially different because F1 filt_w was the weekly variant of a perp funding filter that failed its train gate (net Sharpe -0.40); dbasis has no funding exposure and its exits are fixed by the contract calendar, not by a funding estimate

instrument_model.bars: per coin and hour: (ts, spot_open / F_open, spot_close / F_close), F = the held quarterly (USD per coin), on the intersection of hours; the held quarterly is the nearest one with more than 3 days to expiry and rolls at the first 01:00 UTC with no more than 3 days left (the Wednesday 01:00 UTC bar for a Friday 08:00 delivery)
instrument_model.funding_for_costs: none (a delivery future pays no funding)
instrument_model.roll: the bar that opens at the roll time carries a return between two contracts and is flat in every rule; a held position continues on the next contract from the following bar, so both legs are charged twice per roll
instrument_model.position: +1 = long 1 coin spot and short the inverse quarterly with face F0 USD = the futures price at entry (value S x F0 / F, the ratio S / F), 1x; 0 = flat; never negative
instrument_model.benchmark: equal-weight buy-and-hold of the same coins' USD-M perps with catalogue costs and funding (amendment 8 point 8)

windows.holdout: 2024, sealed, human approval only, without BTC/ETH/SOL
windows.reserved: 2025-01-01 until the forward window start, never read

instances.rule: Daily 01:00 UTC on the close of the 00:00 bar. B = (F/S - 1) x 365 / days to the held quarterly's expiry. Enter +1 at B >= theta; exit to 0 at B < theta / 2; otherwise keep. The roll (3 days before expiry) is an exit: on the new contract (decided at 02:00 on its first close) the position starts again only at B >= theta.

Only at the first 01:00 UTC after a roll day (roll time + 1 day), on the close of the 00:00 bar: enter +1 if B >= theta and hold until the next roll (3 days before expiry); otherwise flat until then. Flat from each roll time.

Mondays 01:00 UTC on the close of the 00:00 bar: hold +1 in the k coins with the highest B among those with B >= 5 % (ties by coin name), 0 elsewhere, for the week. Flat on every roll bar; a held coin continues on the next contract.

expected.correlation_with_f1: positive: both harvest the leverage-demand premium; P(at least one PASS across F1 and F2) ~0.06-0.18, not the sum (design)
